name: 对比矩阵

prompt_template.subject: {comparison_topic}

prompt_template.style: clean matrix with check/cross icons and color-coded ratings
prompt_template.color_scheme: green #10b981 for yes/advantage, red #ef4444 for no/disadvantage, gray #6b7280 for neutral
prompt_template.labels: item names in left column bold, attribute names in header row, cell values with icons

category_tips.biology: 物种对比按分类学层级；基因组大小用数值；栖息地用图标
category_tips.medicine: 药物对比按机制/副作用/适应症；剂量用数值；相互作用用色块
category_tips.chemistry: 分子对比按结构/极性/沸点；键长用数值；官能团用结构式
category_tips.physics: 粒子对比按质量/电荷/自旋；单位用 SI；衰变类型用图标
category_tips.engineering: 材料对比按强度/密度/耐温；数值用 SI；应用场景用图标
category_tips.math: 分布对比按均值/方差/定义域；公式用 LaTeX；概率密度用曲线

examples: Comparison matrix of cell types, grid layout. Rows: Prokaryote, Eukaryote Animal, Eukaryote Plant. Columns: Nucleus, Mitochondria, Cell Wall, Chloroplasts, Size range. Cells color-coded: green #10b981 checkmark for present, red #ef4444 cross for absent. Item names bold in left column, attribute names in header row. Bilingual labels 原核生物 (Prokaryote). White background. 4K, publication-ready.

Split screen comparison of mitosis vs meiosis, vertical divider. Left side: Mitosis 有丝分裂 with 4 phases (prophase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase), 2 daughter cells, diploid. Right side: Meiosis 减数分裂 with 8 phases, 4 daughter cells, haploid. Color-coded: blue #3b82f6 for mitosis, purple #8b5cf6 for meiosis. Labels on each side. 4K, textbook style.

Venn diagram comparison of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning. Three overlapping circles: blue Supervised, green Unsupervised, orange Reinforcement. Intersections labeled with shared traits: Supervised+Unsupervised = labeled/optimized, Supervised+RL = feedback signal, Unsupervised+RL = exploration. Center intersection: all ML. Bilingual labels 监督学习 (Supervised Learning). 4K, education style.
accuracy_tips: 对比维度准确对齐；不虚构属性或数值；颜色编码一致（绿=是/优势，红=否/劣势）；数值带单位和量级；中英文术语对照准确；对比项属于同类可比范畴。
